national_news.title: India’s Trade Agreements in Action and Export Performance
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports touched US$ 232.73 billion, registering an 11.37% growth.
The India-UAE CEPA (effective May 1, 2022) remains India's largest individual FTA export market, with bilateral trade crossing US$ 100 billion in FY 2024-25.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Addresses PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organized by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance.
Announced a focused month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to engage them with the formal financial system via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
Emphasized maintaining focus on Priority Sector Lending (PSL) and enhancing financing across agriculture and horticulture value chains.

national_news.title: India's Medical Tourism Industry Valued at $8.7 Billion in 2025, Projected to Reach $16.2 Billion by 2030
bullets: India's medical value travel (MVT) market stood at $8.7 billion in 2025, drawing over 5 lakh foreign patients, and is projected to scale up to $16.2 billion by 2030.
Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Somalia, and Oman emerged as the top source countries for medical tourists visiting India for treatments and AYUSH wellness therapies.
According to the Medical Tourism Index, India ranks 10th globally among medical tourism destinations and 5th in the Asia-Pacific wellness tourism market.

national_news.title: TDB Backs Orthograft to Commercialize Advanced Biological Dressings for Wound Care
bullets: The Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science and Technology (DST) provided financial assistance to Gujarat-based startup Orthograft.
The funding supports the project 'Production Setup of Advanced Tissue Derived Biological Dressings' for treating chronic wounds, diabetic foot ulcers, and burns.
The startup operates out of the Gujarat government's Savli Technology Business Incubator in Vadodara and holds two approved US patents.

national_news.title: India and Malaysia Pledge Deeper Cooperation on Public Administration and Governance
bullets: India and Malaysia held their 2nd Joint Working Group Meeting, reviewing bilateral cooperation in public administration, capacity building, and governance reforms.
Discussions highlighted India's CPGRAMS platform and the AI-enabled voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' for grievance redressal, alongside Malaysia's digital government initiatives.
Both nations adopted the Action Plan for the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership (2027-2029) to cement institutional engagement.

national_news.title: Cabinet Approves Four Railway Multi-Tracking Projects Worth Rs 9,450 Crore
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved four multi-tracking railway projects spanning West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh, covering an increased network of about 410 km.
The total estimated cost is approximately Rs. 9,450 crore, targeted for completion by 2030-31 under the PM-Gati Shakti National Master Plan.
The capacity augmentation is projected to generate an additional freight traffic of 76 MTPA (Million Tonnes Per Annum) while reducing oil imports and CO2 emissions.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Minister Flags Off Expanded Transshipment Cargo Operations at Delhi Airport
bullets: Union Minister for Civil Aviation Ram Mohan Naidu flagged off the scaled-up phase of India's transshipment cargo reform at Delhi International Airport Limited's Transshipment Excellence Centre on August 19, 2026.

The reform removes mandatory re-screening of transshipment cargo, successfully reducing average end-to-end transit time from 60 hours to 20 hours based on the Chennai-Delhi-Frankfurt Proof of Concept.

The expanded network connects four additional domestic origins (Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Hyderabad) and two international destinations (London, Copenhagen), projected to increase monthly cargo carriage by nearly 80 percent to 3,183 MT.

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 New Electric Buses, Expanding Fleet Past 5,000
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The expansion takes Delhi's total electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, while the overall bus fleet has reached approximately 6,800.
The government plans to convert the entire DTC fleet to electric and expand the total fleet to around 14,000 by 2028-29.
New initiatives include the Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with panic buttons and Delhi Police 112.

national_news.title: Youth Drive Formal Employment Growth with 79% of New UANs Belonging to 18-30 Age Group
bullets: According to the 'Pulse FY2026' report, 79 percent of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years.
The 21-25 age group accounted for over 35 percent of new UANs, emerging as the largest segment entering formal employment.
Women accounted for nearly 28 percent of new UANs generated, and tier-II and tier-III cities accounted for nearly 69 percent of the deployed workforce.

national_news.title: RDI Fund Equipped with Stringent Safeguards to Protect Taxpayers and Private Capital: Dr Jitendra Singh
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund includes a Conflict of Interest policy with stringent safeguards to protect both taxpayers' money and private capital.
Private equity sources are expected to contribute 50 percent of the investment under the RDI Fund model.

national_news.title: Government Prioritizes Cost-Effective, High-Quality Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari stated that the government's foremost priority is providing high-quality and cost-effective infrastructure without compromising standards.
Speaking at the 4th edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi, he announced that the Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore.
The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link tender eligibility to performance assessments of contractors and consultants preparing Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 Zero-Emission Electric Buses to Expand Green Fleet
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 new zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The addition pushes Delhi's electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, with a total bus fleet of around 6,800, under plans to reach 14,000 buses by 2028-29.
A new Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with the Delhi Police 112 emergency system were also launched.

national_news.title: RDI Fund Features Stringent Safeguards to Protect Taxpayers' Money and Private Capital
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund involves a shared responsibility with 50 per cent of investment expected from private equity sources.
Inter-ministerial consultations are underway to make the RDI Fund framework more inclusive for strategic technology requirements.

national_news.title: Government Priority on Cost-Effective and High-Quality Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari addressed the fourth edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi.
The Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore, focusing on advanced technologies like precast methodology and Tunnel Boring Machines.
The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link consultant tender eligibility to performance assessments of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

national_news.title: India's FTA Landscape and Export Performance Show Steady Growth
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026 (FY 2026-27), combined exports were estimated at US$ 232.73 billion, marking an 11.37% year-on-year increase.

The India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), signed in a record 88 days and operational since May 2022, made the UAE India's largest individual FTA export market at US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Month-Long Youth Campaign at PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organised in New Delhi by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, aimed at youth above 16 years to integrate them into the formal financial system.
The initiative will be coordinated through the Indian Banks' Association (IBA) via a common online portal and physical outreach across educational and skilling institutions.

national_news.title: India's Medical Tourism Sector Valued at $8.7 Billion in 2025, Projected to Reach $16.2 Billion by 2030
bullets: India's medical tourism market reached approximately $8.7 billion in 2025, drawing over 5.07 lakh foreign patients, and is projected to scale up to $16.2 billion by 2030.
Top source countries for medical tourists in 2025 included Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Somalia, Turkmenistan, Oman, and Kenya.
India ranks 10th globally among medical tourism destinations and features prominently in wellness tourism spanning AYUSH practices.

national_news.title: TDB Supports Gujarat Startup Orthograft for Advanced Tissue-Derived Wound Dressings
bullets: The Technology Development Board (TDB) of the Department of Science and Technology (DST) provided financial assistance to Gujarat-based startup Orthograft.
The funding supports the project 'Production Setup of Advanced Tissue Derived Biological Dressings' for treating chronic wounds, diabetic foot ulcers, and burns.
Orthograft is a DPIIT-accredited medical device startup operating from the Savli Technology Business Incubator in Vadodara, holding two approved US patents.

national_news.title: India and Malaysia Deepen Cooperation in Public Administration and Governance
bullets: India and Malaysia held the 2nd India-Malaysia Joint Working Group (JWG) meeting to strengthen bilateral cooperation in public administration, capacity building, and governance reforms.
Discussions highlighted India's CPGRAMS platform and the AI-enabled voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' launched by DARPG on May 30, 2026, for citizen-centric grievance redressal.
The Malaysian side presented the Action Plan for the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership: 2027-2029 to implement various areas under the MoU.

national_news.title: Young Workers Drive Formal Employment Growth in FY2026
bullets: 79% of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years.
The 21-25 age group accounted for over 35% of the total new UANs generated, representing the largest segment entering formal employment.
Nearly 64,000 apprenticeship contracts were facilitated under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme, with the automotive sector leading at over 51%.

national_news.title: Lakshya Sen and Other Indians Progress at BWF World Championships
bullets: Ace shuttler Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand moved into the pre-quarterfinals after defeating the US pair Lauren Lam and Allison Lee.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the second round in women's singles by overcoming Myanmar's Thet Htar Thuzar in straight games.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF World Championships in New Delhi
bullets: Mixed doubles pair Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto entered the pre-quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships held at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.
Top Indian pairs like Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced after a walkover in the tournament.
Young shuttler Ayush Shetty previously produced a major upset by defeating world number one and defending champion Shi Yu Qi of China.

national_news.title: President Murmu Interacts with Officer Trainees of IIS and ISS
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu interacted with officer trainees of the Indian Information Service (IIS) and Indian Statistical Service (ISS) at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
Emphasized that effective communication and credible information are essential pillars of a vibrant and responsive democracy.
Stressed that public servants must continuously upgrade knowledge and skills to handle the rapidly changing landscape of technology, media, economics, and public policy.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Seeks Centre's Response on Implementing K. Radhakrishnan Committee Recommendations for NTA
bullets: The Supreme Court reiterated the need to institutionalize the National Testing Agency (NTA) with secure infrastructure and cyber-security systems during NEET-UG 2026 hearings.
The Ministry of Education was directed to file an affidavit on steps taken to implement the K. Radhakrishnan Committee recommendations, as nuanced by the Nandan Nilekani Committee.
The K. Radhakrishnan Committee was formed after the NEET-UG 2024 paper leak controversy and submitted 101 recommendations in October 2024 to overhaul public examinations.

national_news.title: India's Economic Growth Driven by Infrastructure, Inclusion, and Manufacturing: Ashwini Vaishnaw
bullets: Union I&B Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated at the UP-Japan Investment Summit 2026 that India's economy is growing in the 6 to 8 percent range, supported by robust public investment of around USD 130 billion annually.

Key infrastructural milestones highlighted include 99.6 percent railway network electrification, addition of 38,000 km of railway lines, and the world's second-largest road network with 65,000 km of new highways.
UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath noted that the state has tripled its budget and per capita income over nine years, hosting over 96 lakh MSME units and 22,000 start-ups.

national_news.title: India’s Free Trade Agreements and Export Performance in FY 2025-26
bullets: In FY 2025-26, India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports rose by 11.37% year-on-year to an estimated US$ 232.73 billion.
The India-UAE CEPA, which came into force on May 1, 2022, was India's largest individual FTA export market with merchandise exports worth US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Agriculture and Rural Development Ministries Adopt 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap
bullets: The Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development organised a commitment programme to implement the 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' vision announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan administered a collective pledge to officials, scientists, farmers, and FPOs to build a self-reliant and prosperous India.
The roadmap focuses on enhancing agricultural productivity, product quality, safety, and establishing a strong global footprint for Indian agricultural exports.

national_news.title: PIB Gangtok Conducts Media Workshop on VB-G RAM G and Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Gangtok, organised a 'Vartalap' programme focusing on the VB-G RAM G scheme and the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan in Sikkim.
Discussions highlighted the implementation, outreach, and rural development impact of the VB-G RAM G scheme in the state.
Law enforcement authorities and media representatives collaborated to address substance abuse and promote anti-narcotics measures under the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasises Integrated Farming
bullets: The 97th Annual General Meeting of the ICAR Society was held at the National Agricultural Science Complex (NASC), New Delhi, chaired by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
The meeting emphasized integrated farming systems, soil health, balanced fertilizer use, and timely access to quality seeds to diversify the incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Leaders stressed building a demand-driven research ecosystem and strengthening India's export viability through quality, processing, and compliance with global standards.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Month-Long Campaign for Youth Banking
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organised by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, concluding with a focus on seven key growth themes.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to integrate them into the formal financial system.
The initiative will utilize a common online portal and physical outreach via educational institutions to support youth financial needs across education, employment, and entrepreneurship.

national_news.title: Overview of News Services Division of All India Radio
bullets: The News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio operates 24X7, broadcasting 607 bulletins daily in 92 languages and dialects.
News broadcasting in India originated with the Indian Broadcasting Company in Bombay on July 23, 1927, before coming under government control and being renamed All India Radio in 1936.
NSD is headed by a Director General (News) from the Indian Information Service and manages regional units, external services, and multi-lingual news dissemination.

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant Hits Milestone of 100 Test Sixes
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian player and only the fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle.
Pant achieved the milestone in just his 51st Test, making him the fastest player to complete 100 sixes in the format.
India set Sri Lanka a target of 372 runs in the match, with contributions from top-scorer Devdutt Padikkal and bowler Manav Suthar.

national_news.title: Indian Badminton Players Continue Strong Run at World Championships
bullets: Indian ace shuttler Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the pre-quarterfinals.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the next round in the women's singles category.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF World Championships
bullets: The mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto reached the pre-quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi.
Top Indian pairs like Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also advanced to the pre-quarterfinals.
Young shuttler Ayush Shetty produced a major upset by defeating world number one Shi Yu Qi of China earlier in the tournament.

national_news.title: India's Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) Drive Record Merchandise and Services Exports
bullets: India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports rose by 11.37% to an estimated US$ 232.73 billion, supported by expanding Free Trade Agreements (FTAs).
The India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), enacted on May 1, 2022, emerged as India's largest individual FTA export market with US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Ministries Launch 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap for Agriculture and Rural Development
bullets: A commitment program was organized in New Delhi to operationalize 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Independence Day.
Administered a collective pledge to officials, scientists, FPOs, and Lakhpati Didis to boost quality, safety, and global market compliance for Indian agriculture.
Focuses on connecting Indian farm produce (spices, fruits, traditional foods) directly to international export markets.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasizes Integrated Farming
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan chaired the 97th AGM of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Society at NASC, New Delhi.
Stressed integrated farming systems, balanced fertilizer use, and improved soil health to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Called for a demand-driven research ecosystem and strong ICAR-industry partnerships to align agricultural production with global standards.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Youth-Focused Banking Campaign
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026, concluding with a focus on agriculture, priority sector lending, and credit card business.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to enhance formal financial inclusion via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
Emphasized granular monitoring of Priority Sector Lending (PSL) targets and developing digital portals for youth banking and skilling services.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises 'Vartalaap' Media Workshop in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, organized a regional media workshop titled 'Vartalaap' in Gopeshwar, Chamoli on August 20.
The workshop focuses on communicating Central Government welfare schemes, women/youth empowerment, farmer welfare, healthcare, GI tags, and One District One Product (ODOP).
Targeted at print, electronic, and digital media professionals in rural and border areas to ensure accurate grassroot dissemination of public service initiatives.

national_news.title: Guidelines and Application Circulars for Akashwani Annual Awards
bullets: Akashwani released guidelines and application forms for its prestigious annual awards, including the K. L. Sharma Award for Best Correspondent and the Best PTC Award.
The awards recognize exceptional contributions by journalists, newsreaders, and correspondents associated with the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio.
Categories include honors for best news reading, reporting, and regional news broadcasting excellence.

national_news.title: Overview of the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio
bullets: The News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio operates under the motto “Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya”, broadcasting 24x7 in major languages and dialects.
The first news bulletin in India was broadcasted on July 23, 1927, from the Bombay Station under the Indian Broadcasting Company, which later became All India Radio on June 8, 1936.
NSD currently produces 607 daily news bulletins totaling 3,150 minutes across 92 languages and dialects, supported by correspondents nationwide and international bureaus.

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant Becomes Fastest to Hit 100 Sixes in Test Cricket
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian and only the fourth player globally to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
He achieved the milestone in just his 51st Test match during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle.
India set Sri Lanka a target of 372 runs in the match.

national_news.title: Government Approves Incentive Scheme for Domestic PNG Connections
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas approved an Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections to fast-track active piped cooking gas connections.
Eligible City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities will receive an additional 200 Standard Cubic Meters of lower-priced domestic gas for every incremental billed connection.
The scheme aims to expand the Piped Natural Gas network, lower gas-sourcing costs, and provide households a safer alternative to LPG and traditional fuels.

national_news.title: India's FTA export landscape expands with record merchandise and services exports
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports alone touching US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports grew by 11.37% year-on-year to reach US$ 232.73 billion.
The India-UAE CEPA (effective May 1, 2022) emerged as India's largest individual FTA export market, crossing US$ 100 billion in bilateral trade within three years.

national_news.title: Ministry of Agriculture adopts 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' roadmap for rural development
bullets: A commitment programme was organized in New Delhi for departments under the Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development to implement 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara'.
The framework translates Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Independence Day roadmap into action for agriculture, food processing, and rural empowerment.
The event saw a collective pledge by officials, scientists, Lakhpati Didis, and FPO representatives to align efforts with building a self-reliant and prosperous India.

national_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan chairs 97th ICAR Annual General Meeting
bullets: The 97th Annual General Meeting of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Society was held at the National Agricultural Science Complex (NASC), New Delhi.
Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan emphasized integrated farming systems and demand-driven research to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
The ministers highlighted the vision of achieving self-reliance in agriculture, pulses, oilseeds, and strengthening FPOs to realize Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announces month-long youth banking campaign starting October 2, 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organised by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, concluding with a focus on growth strategies for public sector banks.

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long banking outreach campaign starting October 2, 2026, targeted at youth above 16 years of age through the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
The initiative will feature a common online portal for single-window access to banking, skilling, and entrepreneurship opportunities, alongside physical outreach across educational institutions.

national_news.title: Jharkhand Government Cancels 44 Recruitment Exams Over Irregularities
bullets: The Jharkhand government cancelled 44 recruitment exams conducted by JPSC and outsourced agencies since 2014 due to alleged irregularities.
Cancelled exams include recruitment for civil judges, assistant professors, drug inspectors, and the JSSC-Combined Graduate Level examination.
The state announced plans to request a fast-track court for irregularities cases and established an internal vigilance cell and reform committee led by IAS officer Amitabh Kaushal.

national_news.title: Government Approves Incentive Scheme to Promote Domestic PNG Connections
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and National Gas approved an Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections, effective from the 1st of next month.
City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities will be allocated an additional 200 Standard Cubic Meters of lower-priced domestic gas for every incremental billed Domestic PNG connection.
The scheme aims to fast-track the expansion of the current 1.74 crore domestic Piped Natural Gas connections and lower gas-sourcing costs.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports announced the National Sports Awards 2025, based on recommendations by a selection committee chaired by former Supreme Court judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.

Prominent sportspersons awarded the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance include Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Treesa Jolly (Badminton), Vidit Santosh Gujarathi and Divya Jitendra Deshmukh (Chess), among others.

The Dronacharya Award in the regular category was conferred on coaches Parveer Singh (Athletics), Chhote Lal Yadav (Boxing), and Neha Nandkumar Chavan (Shooting), while the Army Paralympic Node, Pune, received the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar.

national_news.title: India's FTA Export Performance and Strategic Trade Growth Highlighted in PIB Report
bullets: India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026 (FY 2026-27), combined exports grew by 11.37% year-on-year to reach an estimated US$ 232.73 billion.

national_news.title: Agriculture Ministry Launches 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap for Rural Development
bullets: A commitment program was organized in New Delhi for the Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development to implement the 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' announced by the Prime Minister.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan administered a collective pledge to officials, scientists, farmers, and Lakhpati Didis to build a self-reliant and empowered India.
The roadmap focuses on moving beyond domestic production increases to ensuring quality, safety, and global market compliance for Indian agricultural products.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasizes Integrated Farming for Small Farmers
bullets: Union Minister of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan chaired the 97th Annual General Meeting of the ICAR Society at NASC, New Delhi.
The meeting stressed integrated farming systems, timely availability of quality seeds, balanced fertilizer use, and enhanced soil health to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Union Minister of State Bhagirath Choudhary highlighted the goal of achieving self-reliance in pulses, oilseeds, seeds, and livestock to realize Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Month-Long Youth Banking Campaign Starting October 2026
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) under the Ministry of Finance organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026 in New Delhi.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, targeted at youth above 16 years to integrate them into the formal financial system.

A common online portal/application is envisaged to provide single-platform access to banking services, skilling, and entrepreneurship opportunities, coordinated via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant becomes fastest and first Indian to hit 100 Test sixes
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian player and only the fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
He achieved this milestone in just his 51st Test match, making him the fastest player to complete 100 sixes in the format.
The milestone was reached during the first Test match of the series played in Galle against Sri Lanka.

national_news.title: Iran States Strait of Hormuz Will Remain Closed Until Conditions Met
bullets: Iran announced that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed to maritime traffic until conditions under the 14-point MoU with the US are fully met.
Tehran's conditions include the complete removal of foreign sanctions and the cessation of military operations.
US President Donald Trump maintained that the strait remains open and operating under a US blockade.

national_news.title: MEA Highlights Credibility of India's Election Machinery and Foreign Policy Updates
bullets: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that the credibility and robustness of India's election machinery are well-established globally.
India offered condolences and expressed solidarity with Indonesia following a massive earthquake.
MEA reiterated India's firm stance against cross-border terrorism and ongoing energy cooperation discussions with Bangladesh.

national_news.title: UDISE+ 2025-26 Report Highlights Progress in School Education
bullets: The UDISE+ 2025-26 report covers 14.67 lakh schools, 1.03 crore teachers, and 24.72 crore students across India.
The overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) stands at a favorable 24:1, comfortably within the NEP 2020-recommended benchmark of 30:1.
Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) at the Secondary stage improved to 71.7%, while the Middle stage GER stood at 89.6%.

national_news.title: India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV Commences
bullets: The 15th edition of the India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV (2026) is conducted from 18 to 31 August 2026 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani, Thailand.
Both Indian Army and Royal Thai Army contingents comprise 85 personnel each, with the Indian side represented primarily by the 9 Gorkha Rifles.
Instituted in 2006, the exercise focuses on joint counter-insurgency and terrorist operations in jungle and semi-urban environments under Chapter VII of the UN Charter.

national_news.title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan Outlines 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap for Agriculture and Rural Development
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan led a commitment programme to translate 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara'—announced by PM Narendra Modi from the Red Fort—into ground action.
The roadmap focuses on integrating the Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development to boost agricultural production, quality, and global market compliance.
Key stakeholders including Lakhpati Didis, FPOs, scientists, and Self-Help Groups participated to build a self-reliant and developed India.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Focuses on Integrated Farming and Agricultural Transformation
